evidence: apps/office/src/cppu/inc/com/sun/star/uno/Type.test.ts#matches original value construction, acquired names, lifetime and description replacement
semantic.justification: Original uno::Type one-pointer value declarations in Type.h and exact inline member bodies in Type.hxx are bound into a single actual Type class; JavaScript class member definition requires one owner, not a substitute constructor/prototype patch or second class. Default VOID reads the actual static cache cell and acquires once. Exact class/OUString and terminated ASCII overloads reuse real C factories and shared SAL strings. Pointer and copy constructors acquire; both no-acquire enum tags transfer the pointer without acquisition. Native rvalue construction selects the original copy constructor; there is no move constructor. Explicit dispose maps the unconditional original destructor. Copy assignment reuses original acquire-before-release/self-identity logic; move assignment swaps both pointers and returns this. Acquired names, borrowed getTypeLibType, output replacement description, original class cast/equality operators/compatibility delegate to existing shared owners. The actual CPPU header imports the generated UDK TypeClass enum; original dependency direction is retained without a reverse edge. Complete original normal and sanitized native calls and portable replay compare initialized counts/names/common fields and all15 basic Type value pairs. Deliberately null no-acquire values are retained without destruction and observed only through valid nullable pointer/predicate methods. Physical SAL new/delete operators/ABI, const and rvalue enforcement, Array/legacy/UnoType templates, native threading/shutdown and full Any/Reference/default RuntimeException/case/UI consumers remain unverified; system libraries are uninstrumented and leak detection is disabled. No original body/method is substituted and broad parity flags stay false. Complete original low-level PropertyBag and OPropertyContainerHelper retain separate default/holder/descriptor ownership, declared real/Any/held locations, lossless UNO normalization, untouched unchanged outputs, original diagnostics, default empty-name rejection, forced MAYBEVOID, removal/default semantics and name-sorted left-first descriptor merge. PropertyDescription retains signed handles, original nested location enum and logical64 size_t maximum. Type now exposes its actual private pointer through one stable compiler lvalue; generated Property no longer writes that private field reflectively. Property.unacquired projects only existing declared fields, with no new UNO value/refcount/type provider; sorting temporaries use actual generated Property values. Newly consumed generated exceptions retain real Type/Any/copy/move/Context behavior through the injected host ABI. Source removed-holder retention is preserved as CALC-547/WRITER481. The separate OPropertyBag UNO service, PropertyArray/notification helpers, SfxDocumentMetaData and complete DOCX/XLSX shell/UI remain unfinished; STL allocation/move traces, physical ABI, native threading and final/access/const enforcement remain unqualified.
